summary: Developer Center is reachable after Privy OTP login and the /developer route itself is live, but the visible API Docs / SDK Examples / CLI guidance are not contract-consistent. The page still steers CLI users toward dashboard-issued sandbox tokens and sandbox-only commands, while the current CLI README documents Automation Access bootstrap plus broader command families. SDK examples also hard-code localhost endpoints instead of the current live base URL.

contract_findings.title: CLI bootstrap guidance is stale
contract_findings.mismatch: Live API Docs tell users to obtain a sandbox token from the Web UI and call `toani ... sandbox stats` directly, but the current CLI contract recommends `Profile -> Automation Access` followed by `toani config init --url ... --token <AUTOMATION_TOKEN>`.

contract_findings.title: CLI is presented as sandbox-only
contract_findings.mismatch: Visible CLI guidance only documents a sandbox stats invocation, while the current CLI README exposes broader `auth`, `credentials`, `tokens`, `service-accounts`, `sandbox`, `audit`, and `config` command families.

contract_findings.title: SDK examples use stale localhost base URLs
contract_findings.mismatch: Visible SDK examples hard-code `http://localhost:8082` for SDK and raw fetch examples, which is inconsistent with the live environment target and the CLI README default/example base URL `https://dev-credbridge.bitkinetic.com/`.

contract_findings.title: Token issuance guidance is narrower than the current CLI contract
contract_findings.mismatch: The live page frames token issuance as `Tokens` page or restricted `/api/v1/auth/access-token` for sandbox use, but the current CLI contract documents multiple bearer-token flows including `auth token create`, `auth access-token create`, and service-account tokens.
